why_ai: Descriptive telemetry dashboards are what AI-native analytics tools generate directly.
why_clarity: Pipelines are codified, but the causal why questions have no checkable answer.
why_digital: Event telemetry in, analytics software out, sold globally online.

why_ai: Comparing arriving events against expected schema is continuous mechanical checking.
why_clarity: An event either matches its specification or it does not, within hours.
why_digital: Event streams validated entirely in software.

why_ai: Only the vendor sees thousands of comparable titles, a data position AI cannot replicate.
why_clarity: Benchmarks are defined aggregates recomputed routinely across genres.
why_digital: Cross-customer telemetry aggregated into an online data product.

why_ai: Definition management and number reconciliation are mechanisable once teams agree.
why_clarity: Reconciled numbers either match across tools or they do not.
why_digital: Metric definitions reconciled across digital systems.

why_ai: Schema governance is software work that AI tooling can largely maintain.
why_clarity: Schema coherence is judged loosely and breaks show only when analyses look wrong.
why_digital: Event schemas exist only as code and data.

why_ai: Joining build, config and campaign logs to metrics is integration plus causal inference software.
why_clarity: Attributed causes are rarely verifiable against ground truth.
why_digital: Studio system logs joined in the data platform.

why_ai: Causal explanation is ambiguous analyst work, but AI investigation tools target it directly.
why_clarity: Analysts each form different hypotheses and the true cause is seldom confirmed.
why_digital: Telemetry analysed and answers delivered on screen.

why_ai: Churn and lifetime value scoring is standard machine learning.
why_clarity: Churn predictions are checked against observed retention within weeks.
why_digital: Player event data in, scores out, inside software.

why_ai: Recurring reports and threshold alerts are mechanical and directly automated.
why_clarity: Same weekly report each period with exact, checkable numbers.
why_digital: Data in, scheduled reports and alerts out.

why_ai: Short-deadline causal guesses are skilled, but AI investigation tooling replaces the assembly.
why_clarity: Answers are acted on as established though the cause is never confirmed.
why_digital: Partial data analysed on screen and reported in decks.

why_ai: Version reconciliation and schema validation are automatable code work.
why_clarity: Numbers across client versions either agree or visibly diverge.
why_digital: Client schemas and event data handled entirely in code.
